changed: In a Caller's Box dance that forms a wave on one line ("…; form wave of four" or "Pass the ocean"), then balances it with a line such as "Balance wave of four (NR,WL)" and slides, the balance and slide now import as a Rory O'More after the wave, as they already did without the forming line. A two-place slide there ("Slide right, men slide two places") no longer stays as text. A dance imported earlier picks this up when you import it again.

The Caller's Box adapter folds a short-wave or pass-the-ocean forming line, a balance-wave line and a slide into the forming figure (the balance line's holds, no `balance`) and a balanced `rory_o_more`.
